Guy A Remodeling · Florida

Social media design for a remodeling contractor

Twenty-one posts built as one system: a single teal, bold condensed type, and photography that shows the work before the words do.

The brief

A Florida remodeling company needed a feed that reads as one brand, across services from drywall to roofing.

The system

One teal palette, the house mark in the top corner and a fixed contact strip, so each post is recognisable before the name is read.

The range

Service posts, interior showcases and community posts such as Labour Day and This or That.

Colour, pulled from the posts

Every shade below comes from the client's own artwork.

  • Brand teal#006c6c
  • Bright teal#007878
  • Soft teal#3c9090
  • Deep teal#184848
  • Mist#eaf3f1

Services

Single-service posts, from drywall and flooring to roofing. One idea per post, one clear line of copy.

Kitchen, bath and bedroom

Interior-led posts where the photograph does the selling and the type stays out of its way.

Community and trust

Posts that explain why remodel, and that give the feed a human rhythm.
